verdict.rationale: ClickHouse supports flexible output formats (e.g., the X-ClickHouse-Format header overriding query FORMAT) and offers 'Export backups to your own cloud account' plus migration guides and clickhouse-local for processing/exporting local and remote files via SQL, all pointing to open-format data portability. However, there is no explicit documentation enumerating full data export tooling (e.g., bulk export to CSV/Parquet/JSON at scale) or a stated commitment to avoiding lock-in, so the story is only partially evidenced. Missing for 10: explicit full-dataset export documentation/tutorial, an open-format export guarantee statement, and independent confirmation that a full migration-out is smooth.
